definition: Amenaza del taxón derivada de evidencia externa auditable y versionada. STIMES conserva el score nativo de 05 y genera una vista jerárquica 0-100 usando la primera escala territorial evaluable autorizada.

score_native_05.meaning: Historical/provider multiscope score. Never overwritten by STIMES.

score_stimes_100.meaning: Semantic STIMES score in the first evaluable territorial scope. Null for non-evaluable semantic states.

score_numeric_projection_100.meaning: Computational projection. Equals score_stimes_100 when evaluable and 0 when the semantic score is non-evaluable.

score_numeric_projection_is_placeholder.meaning: True only when numeric 0 is the authorized technical placeholder rather than a semantic score.

semantic_rules: technical numeric zero != semantic score zero

numeric_projection_rule.downstream_use: Allowed only as a technical numeric projection where a numeric percentage input is required; the semantic state remains authoritative and visible.
numeric_projection_rule.replacement: When valid evidence resolves the state, replace placeholder with recalculated score while preserving prior revision/provenance.

logical_unit_rule.implementation: Prefer provider logical_unit. Fallback must include source_identifier before source_reference/source_url.
logical_unit_rule.history: Different date/source dataset identity/scope/country remains historical or independent evidence and is not automatically a conflict.

conflict_rule: True provider same-unit conflict or taxon-level conflict is preserved explicitly. A conflicting evaluable taxon keeps its score according to the v1_2 precautionary projection and simultaneously carries SCORED_WITH_CONFLICT.

scoring.scope_aggregation: 0.8 * highest + 0.2 * mean(up to three highest distinct logical units), cap 100

source_policy.direct_iucn: Preferred direct global source when authenticated acquisition is available; non-acquisition is an explicit state and not zero/absence.
source_policy.external_requery: Only when cached evidence is insufficient, obsolete or a protocol requires refresh.

reliability.rule: Do not invent component weights or a reliability percentage.

human_view.non_evaluable_visibility: Evidence and territorial state cells must state UNKNOWN/TAXON_UNRESOLVED/NO ADQUIRIDO; a displayed numeric 0 is explicitly marked technical/non-semantic in Evidence.

history_rule: Never delete or silently overwrite prior evidence, provider score, contracts or execution revisions.
